definitions.explanation: A feeling of friendliness or kindness toward someone. Refers to benevolent feelings or considerate actions done out of genuine care.
Romantic feelings or attraction toward someone. A somewhat indirect and understated way to describe having feelings for someone.

examples.japanese: ご{好意|こうい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}します→感謝する：06055_kanshasuru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{好意|こうい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧にしたく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I don't want to waste his kindness.

examples.japanese: {好意|こうい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{言|い}っている→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{素直|すなお}→素直：00391_sunao⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}った→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: They're saying it out of goodwill, so you should accept it graciously.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{好意|こうい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{好意|こうい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{寄|よ}せている→寄せる：02329_yoseru⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}づいた。
examples.english: I realized that the other person had feelings for me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{好意|こうい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明|あき}らか→明らか：02351_akiraka⟧だった。
examples.english: It was obvious from his attitude that he had romantic feelings.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {好意|こうい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to have goodwill toward / to have romantic feelings for
- {好意|こうい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{寄|よ}せる→寄せる：02329_yoseru⟧: to show affection, to have feelings for (romantic)
- {好意|こうい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{甘|あま}える→甘える：06624_amaeru⟧: to take advantage of someone's kindness
- {好意|こうい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: out of goodwill
- ご{好意|こうい}: your kindness (polite)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{好意|こうい} vs ⟦{親切|しんせつ}→親切：01144_shinsetsu⟧: Both express kindness, but {好意|こうい} emphasizes the feeling behind the action, while ⟦{親切|しんせつ}→親切：01144_shinsetsu⟧ emphasizes the kind act itself. {好意|こうい} can also imply romantic interest, which ⟦{親切|しんせつ}→親切：01144_shinsetsu⟧ cannot.

{好意|こうい} vs {厚意|こうい}: Both are read こうい and mean goodwill/kindness. {厚意|こうい} is more formal and emphasizes deep, heartfelt kindness. {好意|こうい} is more general and can include romantic overtones.
